selected_information_family.name: MINIMUM_NORMALIZED_RESPONDENT_EVENT_COORDINATE_INCIDENCE_PLUS_AUTHORITY_PROVENANCE
required_information_atoms: M04 response-event identity and raw/canonical value
M09 weight/measure facts and design authority
M10 source-native semantic and transformation authority
M12 empirical predicate grammar and replay identity
M18 deterministic replay and semantic integrity identity

may_assume: M01-M18 are physically available or immutably dereferenceable
response and coordinate incidence is complete for the declared D12 future-authorized frontier
D13B P01-P20 equivalence obligations define correctness

benchmark_lanes.carrier: C10 source snapshots + complete normalized incidence + selected derived facts + exact sidecars
benchmark_lanes.note: This lane may estimate cost of retaining/revalidating redundant source and derived layers; D13 does not require the redundancy.
D14 may measure current extraction/materialization cost but may not present this lane as a lawful lower-cost replacement for C11.
Benchmarking may compare the cost of deriving/reusing fixed contingencies, but D13 does not authorize aggregate-only retention for the future frontier.

benchmark_lanes.carrier: C08/C09 E3 cloud and E4 association summaries
benchmark_lanes.note: Their cost is separable from terminal information retention.

equivalence_assumptions_for_D14.assumption: D14 cost comparisons for a lawful target must preserve the same D12 R01-R14 information frontier and D13B P01-P20 replay semantics.
A fixed exact contingency may be benchmarked as sufficient only for the exact bounded query whose conditioner/target/risk-set/scope/topology/measure are fixed.
Future-selectable conjunction/target/risk-set/discovery workloads must benchmark against respondent-event/coordinate incidence or an exact information-equivalent carrier, not independent marginals.
Source universes remain separate by default; D14 may not reduce cost by false respondent joins, naive pooling or ungoverned backfill.
Typed routing/absence, event topology, weights and authority/provenance are part of workload I/O correctness and cannot be dropped from cost models as metadata noise.
Actor comparator and structural-admission authority lookups are separate governed operations; generated structural position is not a replacement comparator key.

No current populated/source-equivalent instance is certified. Runtime/cardinality figures requiring live data must remain measured only if data later become available or be modeled/synthetic with that limitation explicit.
Materialize-all is not required. D14 must measure on-demand/replay workloads separately from optional cache/materialization strategies and must not select the strategy.

D14_must_not_reopen: whether autonomous forward discovery is terminal
whether reverse positioned-subject possibility inference is terminal
whether structural/stratal empirical production is terminal
whether pairwise summaries can substitute for k-way incidence
whether current shared substrate is full-frontier sufficient
whether aggregate-only E1/E2 is a future-frontier retention substitute
whether source-indexed universe disagreement may be silently pooled
